title: Censys finds 800+ publicly exposed copies of ARTEX, a Chinese-made, AI-powered, open-source penetration testing tool linked to several cyberattacks since July (Zack Whittaker/TechCrunch)
summary: Zack Whittaker / TechCrunch: Censys finds 800+ publicly exposed copies of ARTEX, a Chinese-made, AI-powered, open-source penetration testing tool linked to several cyberattacks since July — Security researchers have discovered hundreds of copies of a Chinese-made AI hacking tool
reason: Item reports a Censys security finding about exposed copies of an existing hacking tool used in cyberattacks; it is not a model release, new AI research artifact, business event, policy action, or new OSS tool announcement. No active rule covers it.
